مَفْؤُودٌ Hit, struck, smitten, affected, or hurt, in his فُؤَاد [or heart, &c.]: (S, A, L:) smitten, or affected, by a disease therein: (S, L:) or by pain therein. (L.) ―
-b2- A man without a heart; having no heart; as also ↓ فَئِيدٌ : (Ks, S, L:) weak-hearted: (T, L:) a coward; (T, M, L, K;) and so ↓ فَئِيدٌ : (T, K:) in this sense it has no verb. (AAF, IJ, M, L.) ＝
-A2- See also فَئِيدٌ, in two places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
